info.title: Healthcare CRM API
info.description:
Backend for a healthcare CRM and its dedicated patient app.

**Log in:** call `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, copy the `access_token`, click **Authorize** and paste it. Demo users are listed in the README (created by `python seed.py`).

**Errors** always look like `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "fields"}}`.

Exchange email + password for an access token and a refresh token.

**Public.** Rate limited per IP+email (`LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE`) and per IP.
Staff get `scope: crm`, patients get `scope: app`.
Errors: `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` (401, same message for unknown email and wrong password),
`MFA_REQUIRED` (401), `RATE_LIMITED` (429).
